title: Eilenberg's swindle: a module whose sum with a nonfinitely generated free module is free is itself absorbed by that free module

standard_prerequisites.name: A nonfinitely generated free module is isomorphic to a countably infinite direct sum of itself, so its direct summands can be shuffled without changing the isomorphism type
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the middle steps of the displayed chain of isomorphisms, which is the whole argument.

standard_prerequisites.name: If a free module is isomorphic to the direct sum of two modules, then summing with one of them again yields the same free module
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies the last step of the chain and hence the statement.

core_obligations: Assume the module together with its complement is isomorphic to the given free module, and display the chain of isomorphisms that first splits the free module into countably many copies of itself, then interleaves the two summands, and finally regroups the interleaved sum into the module together with another copy of the free module (proof lines 38987-38993).
Conclude from the displayed chain that the direct sum of the module with the free module is again isomorphic to the free module, which is the statement (proof line 38992).
proof_roadmap: Split the nonfinitely generated free module into countably many copies of itself (proof lines 38988-38990).
Interleave the two direct summands inside that sum (proof lines 38990-38991).
Regroup to obtain the module summed with a copy of the free module (proof lines 38991-38992).
difficulty_reason: The statement is Eilenberg's swindle for modules over an arbitrary ring: if a module summed with a complement is a nonfinitely generated free module, then the module summed with that free module is isomorphic to the free module (statement lines 38970-38985). The proof is a displayed chain of isomorphisms in which the free module is first identified with a countable direct sum of copies of itself, the two summands are then interleaved inside that sum, and the result is regrouped as the module plus a copy of the free module (proof lines 38987-38993). The proof is deliberately brief, but it is a complete computation rather than an omission: the chain exhibits the required isomorphism, and no step is deferred. The counted statement contains the author's slogan, history and reference environments; the retained preamble defines all three as comment-type, so their bodies, including the two citations they carry, are discarded when the document is typeset, which is why the card needs no bibliography.
